Identification cards, like driver's licenses, are typically carried in wallets for proof of identity.
The turning point for me was recognizing that all these items serve a practical purpose when carried together in a wallet or purse.
This realization made the puzzle's answer clear: things found in a wallet or purse.
Looking back, the difficulty of the puzzle stemmed from the clues being common items that could fit into several categories, not just the one that ultimately made sense.

The solve turned when I stopped treating emergency contact info as just another clue and asked what kind of thing each clue could really be describing. I was no longer trying to rescue travel gear; I was checking whether Photos and Receipts could survive the same tighter read.
